meta.name: funnel-planner
meta.description: Plan a complete affiliate funnel from research to revenue. Triggers on: "plan my affiliate funnel", "create a funnel strategy", "affiliate business plan", "how to start affiliate marketing", "full funnel roadmap", "plan from scratch", "week by week affiliate plan", "chain skills together", "build my funnel", "affiliate marketing roadmap", "step by step affiliate plan", "onboarding plan".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划完整的联盟营销漏斗，从调研到营收
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在从零开始规划联盟营销渠道
copy.tagline_en: Plan a complete affiliate funnel from research to revenue
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are starting your affiliate marketing channel from scratch

howto.what: Claude会根据你的时间、渠道和经验水平，定制一份从研究到收入的联盟营销执行计划。输出包含按周安排的技能顺序、时间估算和每条技能的调用提示。
howto.when: 当你提到“plan my affiliate funnel”、“create a funnel strategy”、“affiliate business plan”等关键词，或要求制定完整的联盟营销计划时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一个从零开始的联盟营销漏斗，我有博客和Twitter，每周5小时。
say.note: Claude会生成一个按周执行的路线图。

say.text: 我已有产品Semrush，请制定提升到每月1000美元的路线图。
say.note: Claude会跳过研究阶段，直接优化现有内容。

say.text: 我需要一个按周执行的联盟营销计划，从研究到收入。

howto.what_en: Claude creates a personalized week-by-week execution roadmap for affiliate marketing, chaining Affitor skills (S1-S7) in the correct order. Output includes skill sequence, time estimates, and exact invocation prompts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "plan my affiliate funnel", "create a funnel strategy", "affiliate business plan", or ask for a complete affiliate marketing plan from scratch.

say_en.text: Plan a complete affiliate funnel from scratch. I have a blog and Twitter, 5 hours per week.
say_en.note: Claude will output a weekly roadmap.

say_en.text: I already promote Semrush. Create a roadmap to scale to $1K/month.
say_en.note: Claude skips research and focuses on optimization.

say_en.text: Generate a week-by-week affiliate plan from research to revenue.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a Markdown plan with time estimates.
